summary: Iteration 276 test: (A) GENUINE AUDIO feature is PARTIALLY BROKEN on backend: only the 5 static /audio/*.mp3 files are correctly served (whale, drums, rain, birds, ocean — all 200/audio/mpeg). However the backend seed (/app/backend/data/sound_frequencies.py) does NOT include the new nature entries freq-rain and freq-forest-birds, and does NOT set audio_url to /audio/*.mp3 on freq-whale, freq-drum, freq-drum-journey, or freq-water. Because _refresh_collection() drops-and-replaces sound_frequencies on every backend boot, any DB-only content is wiped on restart. Additionally, _enrich_sound_frequency_entry falls back to wikimedia .ogg via PUBLIC_DOMAIN_AUDIO_BY_AMBIENT_TYPE, but wikimedia is in UNRELIABLE_AUDIO_HOST_TOKENS, so audio_url is popped for whale/drums entirely — the API returns entries WITHOUT audio_url. Result: /api/sound-frequencies?category=nature returns 14 entries (freq-water + 13 water-deepening) with audio_url=None; /api/sound-frequencies/freq-whale has no audio_url; frontend modal cannot render <audio data-testid=custom-audio-player>. UI test also confirms 'Nature Sounds' category filter has no rain/birds tiles and clicking 'Shamanic Drumming' opens a premium-lock modal (frequency is premium-gated) instead of an audio player. (B) WELCOME JOURNEY feature works end-to-end: fresh signup on / shows welcome-journey-overlay on /dashboard with begin+skip test IDs; Begin path opens GuidedPracticeOverlay 'Breath of Arrival' with steps/voice/timer; guided-exit-btn triggers practice-history POST (verified /api/practice-history returned an entry with practice_id='welcome-arrival' and notes 'Completed Breath of Arrival — first practice') and sets localStorage welcomeJourneyDone=1; reload keeps overlay hidden. Skip path also sets flag and prevents re-appearance. QA user demoqa_740fefc1@example.com (7 sessions) correctly does NOT see the overlay and Sacred Journey widget renders normally.

critical.issue: Missing new nature entries freq-rain and freq-forest-birds. Only freq-water (+13 auto-generated deepening variants) is returned. Seed file /app/backend/data/sound_frequencies.py does not define these two entries.

Response has no audio_url. Seed doesn't set audio_url, and ambient_type='whale' fallback resolves to a wikimedia .ogg URL which is stripped by UNRELIABLE_AUDIO_HOST_TOKENS. Should be wired to /audio/whale.mp3 with audio_credit 'NOAA humpback'.
Same as whale — no audio_url returned. Should point to /audio/drums.mp3.
audio_url is popped (wikimedia gentle_water .ogg blocked). Should point to /audio/ocean.mp3 per spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Because backend does not send audio_url on whale/drum/nature entries, the modal's <audio data-testid=custom-audio-player> is never rendered — the entire genuine-audio feature is unreachable from the UI.

Shamanic Drumming (freq-drum) is premium-gated so anonymous / free users see a 'PREMIUM SOUND JOURNEY' lock modal even when clicked — not the audio player. Consider making at least one drum sample audible without premium so the feature can be experienced (and QA'd).

integration_issues.issue: audio_url wiring not present end-to-end. UI cannot demo the /audio/*.mp3 assets because the API does not include the URL.

action_items: Update /app/backend/data/sound_frequencies.py to add new entries freq-rain and freq-forest-birds (category='nature', audio_url='/audio/rain.mp3' and '/audio/birds.mp3', audio_credit with license) — OR seed them through a code-managed extension that survives _refresh_collection.
Set audio_url and audio_credit directly in the seed on freq-whale ('/audio/whale.mp3', NOAA credit), freq-drum + freq-drum-journey ('/audio/drums.mp3'), and freq-water ('/audio/ocean.mp3').

Alternatively, update _enrich_sound_frequency_entry / PUBLIC_DOMAIN_AUDIO_BY_AMBIENT_TYPE so ambient_type -> /audio/*.mp3 (local, reliable) instead of wikimedia .ogg — that way UNRELIABLE_AUDIO_HOST_TOKENS filter no longer strips them and existing seed entries auto-inherit the URL.
Verify freq-drum is not premium-locked for anonymous demonstration, OR add an unlocked nature entry so users can hear the new audio without Sacred Access.
critical_code_review_comments: Startup seed uses _refresh_collection which drops/replaces sound_frequencies from SOUND_FREQUENCIES on every boot. Any DB-only content (e.g. from admin CMS) is silently wiped — future feature entries must live in the code seed.

_enrich_sound_frequency_entry pops audio_url when it resolves to wikimedia (unreliable-host list), and there is no local fallback to /audio/*.mp3 — the net effect is that whale and drums entries expose no audio_url at all, despite the mp3 assets being served correctly.
The task description claims backend already implements audio_url wiring for the 5 entries — code inspection and API responses show this is NOT the case.

rca of the issue: Missing seed data + audio-URL enrichment bypass. Seed file lacks freq-rain and freq-forest-birds entries, and does not populate audio_url on freq-whale/freq-drum/freq-drum-journey/freq-water. Enrichment function's ambient_type fallback map still points to wikimedia .ogg URLs that are then filtered out by UNRELIABLE_AUDIO_HOST_TOKENS, so no audio_url survives to the API response. Fix: add audio_url + audio_credit directly in the seed for the 5 target entries, and add the 2 new nature entries. Reproduction: GET /api/sound-frequencies/freq-whale — expect audio_url '/audio/whale.mp3', actual response has no audio_url key. Mitigation: edit /app/backend/data/sound_frequencies.py (or the ambient-type map to local paths) and restart backend.
